description: This file defines the `MongoHealthChecker` class, an Akka actor that performs health checks on a MongoDB database by inserting, finding, and deleting a test document. It extends an abstract health actor and periodically verifies MongoDB connectivity and responsiveness, reporting the status.

classes.name: MongoHealthChecker
classes.description: An Akka actor for checking the health of MongoDB, performing insert/find/delete operations to verify database responsiveness.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client when the actor stops to release resources.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for actor instantiation.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines message handlers, notably for processing `CurrentMongoStatus` messages.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Initiates the health check by performing insert/fetch/delete cycle and updates internal status based on the result.

methods.name: generateStatusResponse
methods.description: Performs the health check by inserting a test document, attempting to find it, and then deleting it, returning a completion stage with the health outcome.

methods.name: applyMongoStatus
methods.description: Converts a `CurrentMongoStatus` object into a `StatusInfo` and updates the actor's health status.
